title: achillea odorata var. microphylla
intro: Achillea odorata var. microphylla, commonly known as Dwarf Yarrow or Small-leaved Yarrow, is a perennial herb native to Eastern Europe and Asia. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving menstrual cramps, and soothing digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Dwarf Yarrow include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, making it useful for treating various conditions such as wounds, skin irritations, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Dwarf Yarrow include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
